articles.title: Scepticism as Trump says he’s ending Israel’s $3.8 bn military aid deal
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump says he plans to stop the annual $3.8bn military aid package to Israel by the end of the year.

articles.title: More on Israeli officials’ reaction to Trump’s announcement on US aid
articles.summary: Israeli officials in the finance ministry said on Tuesday they were surprised by Trump’s announcement, the Times of Israel reported, citing the Walla news site. “No formal document was submitted from the Prime Minister’s Office regarding the end of aid,” an official told the site. “The ministry was aware of the intention to end it, but was surprised by the intention to do so immediately.” Defence ministry officials and the military were also reportedly surprised by the announcement.

articles.summary: Israel's finance ministry was unaware of any plans to immediately end US military assistance before President Donald Trump's announcement on Tuesday, according to Israel's Channel 12.
